The regression is a legacy-vs-TC39 decorator mismatch: Nest requires legacy decorator application plus emitted `design:*` metadata; SWC only emits that path when both legacy decorators and metadata are enabled.

Relevant files:

- [babel--v7.24.0:packages/babel-plugin-proposal-decorators/src/index.ts?L26-L66](/r/github.com/sg-evals/babel--v7.24.0/-/blob/packages/babel-plugin-proposal-decorators/src/index.ts?L26-L66) - Selects the legacy visitor when `legacy`/`version: "legacy"` is configured; otherwise uses the TC39 class-features implementation.
- [babel--v7.24.0:packages/babel-plugin-syntax-decorators/src/index.ts?L55-L118](/r/github.com/sg-evals/babel--v7.24.0/-/blob/packages/babel-plugin-syntax-decorators/src/index.ts?L55-L118) - Maps `legacy: true` to `version: "legacy"` and enables the legacy parser mode.
- [babel--v7.24.0:packages/babel-helper-create-class-features-plugin/src/typescript.ts?L4-L23](/r/github.com/sg-evals/babel--v7.24.0/-/blob/packages/babel-helper-create-class-features-plugin/src/typescript.ts?L4-L23) - Explicitly requires `@babel/plugin-transform-typescript`/`@babel/preset-typescript` to run before decorators and other class-feature transforms.
- [babel--v7.24.0:packages/babel-plugin-transform-typescript/src/index.ts?L140-L180](/r/github.com/sg-evals/babel--v7.24.0/-/blob/packages/babel-plugin-transform-typescript/src/index.ts?L140-L180) - Removes TypeScript-only declarations while preserving decorator-bearing class elements for the decorator transform.
- [babel--v7.24.0:packages/babel-standalone/src/preset-stage-3.ts?L5-L39](/r/github.com/sg-evals/babel--v7.24.0/-/blob/packages/babel-standalone/src/preset-stage-3.ts?L5-L39) - Shows decorators configured before class-properties lowering; `decoratorsLegacy` selects legacy mode.
- [babel--v7.24.0:packages/babel-plugin-transform-typescript/test/fixtures/class/decorated-declare-properties/options.json?L1-L6](/r/github.com/sg-evals/babel--v7.24.0/-/blob/packages/babel-plugin-transform-typescript/test/fixtures/class/decorated-declare-properties/options.json?L1-L6) - Working ordering: TypeScript transform, then legacy decorators, then class properties.

- [swc--v1.4.6:crates/swc_ecma_transforms/tests/fixture/legacy-metadata/metadata/nest/injection/output.ts?L19-L50](/r/github.com/sg-evals/swc--v1.4.6/-/blob/crates/swc_ecma_transforms/tests/fixture/legacy-metadata/metadata/nest/injection/output.ts?L19-L50) - SWC’s Nest-style output uses legacy `_ts_decorate`, `_ts_param`, and `_ts_metadata("design:paramtypes", ...)`.
- [swc--v1.4.6:crates/swc_ecma_transforms/tests/fixture/legacy-metadata/metadata/generics/1/output.ts?L1-L12](/r/github.com/sg-evals/swc--v1.4.6/-/blob/crates/swc_ecma_transforms/tests/fixture/legacy-metadata/metadata/generics/1/output.ts?L1-L12) - Demonstrates class decorator metadata emission, including `design:paramtypes`.
- [swc--v1.4.6:crates/swc_ecma_transforms/tests/fixture/legacy-metadata/issues/3319/output.ts?L60-L88](/r/github.com/sg-evals/swc--v1.4.6/-/blob/crates/swc_ecma_transforms/tests/fixture/legacy-metadata/issues/3319/output.ts?L60-L88) - Shows metadata attached through `_ts_decorate` and consumed through `Reflect.getMetadata`.
- [swc--v1.4.6:crates/swc/tests/fixture/sourcemap/011/input/.swcrc?L5-L16](/r/github.com/sg-evals/swc--v1.4.6/-/blob/crates/swc/tests/fixture/sourcemap/011/input/.swcrc?L5-L16) - Required SWC configuration: parser decorators enabled, `transform.legacyDecorator: true`, `transform.decoratorMetadata: true`.
- [swc--v1.4.6:crates/swc_ecma_transforms_proposal/tests/decorators/2022-03-fields--to-es2015/options.json?L1-L7](/r/github.com/sg-evals/swc--v1.4.6/-/blob/crates/swc_ecma_transforms_proposal/tests/decorators/2022-03-fields--to-es2015/options.json?L1-L7) - SWC’s separate TC39 decorator pipeline orders proposal decorators before class-properties lowering.

Configuration diagnosis: Babel must use `["@babel/plugin-transform-typescript"]`/preset first, then `["@babel/plugin-proposal-decorators", { "legacy": true }]` (or `version: "legacy"`), followed by class-properties lowering. SWC must set `parser.decorators: true`, `transform.legacyDecorator: true`, and `transform.decoratorMetadata: true`. If the customer enabled only decorator parsing or used `legacyDecorator: false`/omitted `decoratorMetadata`, SWC can still construct classes and apply a non-legacy/metadata-free transform, but emits no `_ts_metadata("design:paramtypes", ...)`; consequently `reflect-metadata` has nothing to register and Nest’s IoC lookup fails.
